compiled_state.title: PR-FINALIZE-WORKFLOW.md: CHECKS_PENDING wait interval -> excessive re-classification churn (60-120s vs 270s+)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 16032014306c856d662f54bcaf2fe3c1c9a9d3a7
* **Active Workflow:** PR-FINALIZE-WORKFLOW.md CHECKS_PENDING handling

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per PR-FINALIZE-WORKFLOW.md: \"Wait 60–120s, then re-classify.\" The bounded-loop section also states \"Per-iteration sleep on CHECKS_PENDING: 60s default, 120s max.\"

The orchestrator should wait a meaningful interval between re-classification calls when checks are pending — long enough that CI jobs have had time to progress. GitHub CI jobs typically take 2–5 minutes; polling every 60–120s generates 3–5 redundant API calls per job.

#### Actual Behavior

The orchestrator re-classified 5+ times in under 4 minutes while CI checks were still running, generating redundant API calls and user-visible churn. Each cycle returned CHECKS_PENDING with no change in check status.

The user flagged that the orchestrator should wait ~5 minutes between CHECKS_PENDING re-checks, not 60–120 seconds.

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:**
  * pr-finalize-classify.sh called at ~13:23 → CHECKS_PENDING (7)
  * Re-classified at ~13:24 → CHECKS_PENDING (7)
  * Re-classified at ~13:25 → CHECKS_PENDING (6)
  * Re-classified at ~13:25 → CHECKS_PENDING (6)
  * Re-classified at ~13:26 → CHECKS_PENDING (2)
  * Re-classified at ~13:27 → CHECKS_PENDING (3)
* **Known Workarounds:** Orchestrator manually switched to 270s (just under cache TTL) after user flag.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **Active Workflow:** PR-FINALIZE-WORKFLOW.md CHECKS_PENDING loop
* **Skills Invoked:** pr-finalize-classify.sh, ScheduleWakeup
